cd /workspace/submission/src && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib, os
root=pathlib.Path('.')

def read(p): return open(p).read()
def write(p,s): open(p,'w').write(s)

frames = {
 'DataBlockedFrame': ['maximumData'],
 'DatagramFrame': ['length'],
 'MaxDataFrame': ['maximumData'],
 'MaxStreamDataFrame': ['streamId','maximumStreamData'],
 'MaxStreamsFrame': ['maximumStreams'],
 'ResetStreamFrame': ['streamId','applicationProtocolErrorCode','finalSize'],
 'RetireConnectionIdFrame': ['sequenceNumber'],
 'StopSendingFrame': ['streamId','applicationProtocolErrorCode'],
 'StreamDataBlockedFrame': ['streamId','maximumStreamData'],
 'StreamFrame': ['streamId','offset','length'],
 'StreamsBlockedFrame': ['maximumStreams'],
}
for name, fields in frames.items():
    p = root/'de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/frame'/(name+'.java')
    s = read(p)
    for f in fields:
        F = f[0].upper()+f[1:]
        # field declaration
        s = s.replace('@ModifiableVariableProperty protected ModifiableInteger %s;' % f,
                      '@ModifiableVariableProperty protected ModifiableLong %s;' % f)
        # getter type
        s = s.replace('public ModifiableInteger get%s() {' % F, 'public ModifiableLong get%s() {' % F)
        s = s.replace('public ModifiableInteger get%s()' % F, 'public ModifiableLong get%s()' % F)
        # int setter -> long setter
        s = re.sub(r'public void set%s\(ModifiableInteger %s\) \{\s*this\.%s = %s;\s*\}' % (F,f,f,f),
                   'public void set%s(ModifiableLong %s) {\n        this.%s = %s;\n    }' % (F,f,f,f), s)
        s = re.sub(r'public void set%s\(int %s\) \{[^}]*\}' % (F,f),
                   'public void set%s(long %s) {\n        this.%s = ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.%s, %s);\n    }' % (F,f,f,f,f), s)
    # imports: keep ModifiableInteger import only if still used
    if 'ModifiableInteger' not in s.replace('import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.integer.ModifiableInteger;',''):
        s = s.replace('import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.integer.ModifiableInteger;\n','')
    if 'ModifiableLong' in s and 'import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.longint.ModifiableLong;' not in s:
        s = s.replace('import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.ModifiableVariableFactory;',
                      'import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.ModifiableVariableFactory;\nimport de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.longint.ModifiableLong;')
    write(p,s)
print('dto migrated')

# parsers: drop the (int) narrowing casts on varints
for p in (root/'de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/parser/frame').glob('*.java'):
    s=read(p)
    s2=re.sub(r'\(int\) *parseVariableLengthInteger\(\)', 'parseVariableLengthInteger()', s)
    s2=re.sub(r'\( int \) *parseVariableLengthInteger\(\)', 'parseVariableLengthInteger()', s2)
    if s2!=s: write(p,s2)
print('parsers widened')
PY
